notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup -> inbound trial. CTO (Maya Lin) demo request after quick prototype.
- Product: web-based code assistant targeted at small engineering teams; integrates with repos, provides multi-file summarization and contextual completions.
- Primary asks: support for very long contexts (repo-level summarization + single-file), predictable per-request latency for interactive completions, and clear rate limit guidance for early scaling.
- SDKs: strong ask for first-class TypeScript/Node SDK and Python SDK; want example snippets for streaming completions and token accounting.
- Pricing sensitivity: high; team expects low volume initially but worries about token spikes during repo ingestion and retrieval augmentation.
- Security: SMB but handling customer code; wants SOC2 compliance, audit logs, and option to purge data after 30 days. No current KMS need but may request retention controls.
- Deployment preference: start with Hosted API (public cloud), may revisit Dedicated if usage grows.
- Quote from call: "We need predictable latency—our users bounce if completion takes >400ms on single-file prompts." — CTO
- Technical probe: asked about KV/prefix caching and how Redwood handles long-KV caches across sessions.
- Demo notes: ran a quick test with 8k token context, saw ~600ms p95 on Redwood trial; interested in 20k+ context support and cost estimates.
